verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that Grok appears in independent third-party evaluations or leaderboards. It contains only vendor docs, anecdotal community comparisons, and an OpenRouter usage-popularity remark, none of which is an independent benchmark or leaderboard result. The axis clearly applies to a frontier model, so the absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As a founder, the model shows up in independent third-party evaluations and leaderboards, so I am not relying only on vendor-run numbers
